page.overview:
Who is Steve LaPage?

Steve LaPage is a character in Cars 3. He is a Piston Cup racer sponsored by Trunk Fresh.

He was hit by Cam Spinner who went airborne after that and then loses control and hits J.P. Drive. He was severely damaged and didn't finish the race.
